visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male performer wearing a light grey faux-fur hoodie and a black face mask stands on an elevated stage in a club environment. He holds a microphone in his right hand, rapping energetically towards the crowd. The background is dark with intense blue and green laser beams cutting through the air. A DJ booth is visible in the background with equipment and another person standing behind it. (2) Another male wearing a black hoodie and blue jeans enters the frame from the right, moving towards the main performer. The crowd in the foreground is dense, holding up smartphones to record and waving glowing foam sticks. The lighting shifts to include red highlights, creating a high-contrast, vibrant atmosphere. (3) The man in the black hoodie reaches out and pulls the mask off the main performer's face. The main performer continues to hold the microphone as his face is revealed to the audience. The crowd's reaction is intense, with many people visible in the lower frame shouting and cheering excitedly while waving their arms. (4) The main performer, now without his mask, stands at the edge of the stage, engaging more directly with the audience. He raises his left hand in a gesture. The stage floor is covered in confetti. The man in the black hoodie stands behind him, also holding a microphone and shouting along, while the club's lighting continues to flash rhythmically.
